summary.intent: Implement PR 1 of a structural track: introduce a ConvergedTargets type with a private constructor so only the cascade solver's final step can produce targets for range rewrites and E319 checks. It must be behaviour-preserving, with no changeset. PR 2 would then move dependency-range rewriting into the Versioning trait.
summary.outcome: ConvergedTargets/ConvergedTarget were implemented in cascade/converged.rs and cascade.rs, snapshot.rs and version.rs were migrated, and the reviewer's feedback was applied. A new peer_escalation changelog test was added and the changes were committed locally with a signed commit. The branch was not pushed and no PR was opened, and PR 2 and the lead report were not done. Mutants (34 mutants: 19 caught, 15 unviable, 0 missed) and the other gates were run on the pre-lead-message state; the final `just ci` run was stopped after the lead relaxed the process.

repo: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS is cores/5; the machine has 18 cores, so 3 (sysctl hw.ncpu gave nothing usable, getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN worked).

cargo mutants --in-place mutates sources live (e.g. solve_cascade replaced by Ok(Default::default())) and leaves untracked crates/callisto-graph/proptest-regressions/cascade/tests.txt that must be deleted, not committed. Don't edit files while it runs.
`just test` fails inside the sandbox because npm cannot write ~/.npm/_cacache; it passes when run outside the sandbox.

Rust cannot narrow visibility to pub(in crate::commands::snapshot) for an item defined in cascade, so a crate-wide helper like snapshot_targets would weaken a private-constructor guarantee. Moving the caller's loop into cascade keeps settle pub(super).
rewrite_spec was pub and re-exported from lib.rs, but nothing outside the crate used it; its signature change would break the published callisto-graph API, so it was made pub(crate).

apply.rs makes no coverage/rewrite/E319 decisions, it only writes PlannedBump.to and SpecRewrite.to. Carrying a converged token into plan types would break integration-test struct literals, and a test-util feature is forbidden by invariant 6, so plan types stay plain data.
just doc-check rejects intra-doc links to items that became crate-private (the [`rewrite_spec`] link had to be turned into plain code formatting).

code.finding: solve_cascade now keeps a local provisional `targets` BTreeMap and calls ConvergedTargets::settle once the worklist loop finishes; raise() takes `&mut targets` instead of writing out.targets.

The snapshot rewrite loop was replaced with a call into cascade (snapshot_rewrites) so snapshot targets are settled inside cascade; the snapshot_versions clone is needed because platform_version_writes still uses the map and moving it earlier would change which error surfaces first.
Reviewer recommended dropping Deref and Index on ConvergedTargets in favour of version()/get(); these were removed and test call sites updated.

friction: Sandbox blocked npm cache writes, so `just test` had to be re-run outside the sandbox.
Mutation runs take about 10 minutes and block concurrent edits, so the reviewer's changes had to wait and mutants had to be re-run on the final diff.
Several cargo builds and python patch passes were needed to fix test call sites after dropping Deref/Index.
The lead's mid-session instructions conflicted with the original task's rules (just ci, reviewer, mutants), forcing a change of plan after those gates had mostly been run.
open_items: Push the branch with git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch> after merging the latest origin/main, confirm with git ls-remote, link to Entire trail #462 and open the PR with entire trail ci-pr (not yet done).
PR 2 (wp-versioning-ranges): move dependency-range rewriting into the Versioning trait in crates/callisto-model/src/format/bump.rs, with epoch and prerelease tests per grammar (not started).
Send the lead a single short report (under 5 lines) with PR number, sha, gates run and what was not verified; the final `just ci` was stopped and not completed locally.

Reviewer-noted residual weakness: out.targets is an empty Default during the solver loop, so later code reading out.targets inside raise() would silently get None; a larger refactor to build CascadeOutcome after settle was deferred.
Check whether the callisto-graph changelog needs an entry for the rewrite_spec API narrowing.
